wiki.title: Larry Zikmund
wiki.extract: Larry P. Zikmund (born January 25, 1946) is an American politician in the South Dakota Senate. He served as a Republican member for District 14 in the South Dakota House of Representatives beginning in 2015. Zikmund serves on the Commerce and Energy and Transportation Committees and chairs the Military and Veterans affairs and Retirement Laws Committees. His motto is "Experienced. Trusted. Committed" (stylised in all caps).
